verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships its own marketplace repo, superpowers-marketplace, which can be added to Claude Code as a catalog before installing the plugin. It also advertises a 'Skills-search tool for discovery'. The evidence does not show that this search tool works before install rather than inside an installed plugin, and the Claude plugin listing and Antigravity Marketplace are host-platform surfaces. Missing for 10: documented pre-install browsing/search of individual skills, a listing of the catalog's contents, any leaderboard or registry UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of discovery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or search a catalog of available skills — a registry, leaderboard, or marketplace listing — before installing anything

citations.quote:
Add this marketplace to Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace
